$comment: Copy to teams.json and edit, or edit a team on the Teams page and let the app write this file for you. The map works without it — teams are then whatever the manifests and packs say, and nothing is reported as unregistered. What this adds is a canonical id per team, so 'Trading' and 'trading' are one team rather than two, a department to group them by, and 'aliases' for the spellings that mean this team and are not a team of their own.

departments.name: Trading Platform
departments.description: Everything a customer does with their money.

departments.name: Data and Growth
departments.description: What the platform knows about itself, and how it talks to customers.

teams.name: Trading
teams.$comment: aliases is how a rename or a merge is recorded. A scan derives a team from the commit history, so an estate arrives with teams named after people; listing the old spelling here folds it in without touching a single manifest, and deleting it again undoes the merge.

teams.name: Data
teams.description: The warehouse, the loaders and everything built on them.
